# pantechdynamics_access_settings (Resource)

Your organization's access setting. There is one per organization, so declare this resource once. Only an owner's API key can change it, and owners are emailed when it changes. Destroying it leaves the setting as it is (with a warning); set member_baseline = "read" first to go back to the default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Members see nothing unless a policy allows it. Owners and admins are not
# affected. Declare this once per organization; it needs an owner's API key.
# Destroying it leaves the setting as it is.
resource "pantechdynamics_access_settings" "this" {
  member_baseline = "none"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_baseline` (String) What members (not owners or admins) may do without a policy: "read" (view everything, the default) or "none" (only what their policies allow).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "access_settings".
- `updated_at` (String) When the setting last changed, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `version` (Number) Version of the setting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organization's one access setting.
terraform import pantechdynamics_access_settings.this access_settings
```
